image_description: A side-front view of a compact minibus parked on an asphalt road. The vehicle has a two-tone paint scheme: white on the upper half and purple/blue on the lower half, with a pinkish front bumper area. It features a row of rectangular side windows, a sliding door mechanism visible near the front wheel, and red-painted steel wheels. The background includes green trees and a partial view of another car.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Boxy body shape noticeably shorter than a full-size bus, yet tall enough for passengers to stand or sit upright comfortably.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle exhibits a distinct boxy silhouette typical of minibuses (likely a converted van chassis like a Ford Transit or similar). The height relative to the wheel size suggests adequate interior headroom.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large, slightly curved windshield is clearly visible. A continuous row of four rectangular side windows runs along the passenger compartment.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle height is consistent with a minibus. A door frame and handle mechanism are visible just behind the front wheel arch, indicating a forward-mid body entrance.
The vertical seam and handle placement behind the front wheel are characteristic of a sliding door found on this class of vehicle.
The short hood extending from the windshield to the front bumper indicates a front-engine layout, typical for this type of minibus.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is taken from a front-three-quarter angle; the rear of the vehicle is completely occluded by the body itself.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle has a distinct white and purple/blue livery. There appears to be text/logos on the side panel, consistent with commercial or public transport markings.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible front and rear wheels are standard commercial van sizes. The rims appear to be steel, painted red, which is a common aesthetic choice for older fleet vehicles.
Based on the window count (4 side windows) and overall length, the capacity aligns with the 4-10 passenger definition of a minibus.

artifact_observations.location: Side window reflections and interior details
artifact_observations.reasoning: The reflections in the side windows are somewhat muddy and lack sharp environmental mapping. The interior details visible through the glass are indistinct and slightly 'smudged,' lacking the crisp separation between glass surface and interior seats typical of high-fidelity photography.

The geometry of the front bumper and the integration of the headlight assembly appear slightly soft and ill-defined. The boundary between the pink bumper section and the white body panel lacks a sharp, manufactured edge, suggesting slight geometric melting or generation blur.

artifact_observations.location: Text on the side panel below the windows
artifact_observations.reasoning: There is text printed on the white section of the bodywork. While it mimics the shape of letters/words, it is illegible and structurally nonsensical upon close inspection, a classic hallmark of AI-generated imagery failing to render coherent typography.
